goal: Live QA 2026-11-02 (trace read with Owner approval): DeepSeek v4.1 Flash answered a 3-card Tarot reading completely (finish stop, 2891 chars) but the structure check rejected it, so the app showed the library meanings. The rejection cause was not recorded. Record a content-free rejection code in the trace, and ask OpenRouter for JSON mode on Tarot so models return bare JSON instead of a Markdown-fenced block. Acceptance rules stay unchanged. Follow-up 2026-11-03 (Owner approved): JSON mode is removed again — live QA showed DeepSeek taking 22 s and returning a malformed reply with it on; the trace rejection code stays. Follow-up 2026-11-03: the trace rejection code on the next live reading was "title" (DeepSeek answered in 6 s, finish stop). A plain-text section title or body now counts as the requested locale; length, keys and card references still apply.
successCriteria: checkTarotOutputText returns the output or a code (fenced_json, not_json, title, body, card_ids, ...); parseTarotOutput and validateTarotOutput accept exactly what they did.
ai-tarot-reading records rejection.code in the trace finalization when an answer is rejected.
OpenRouter requests for tarot_reading carry no response_format and no Astrology provider settings (JSON mode removed 2026-11-03).
Deno shared tests, endpoint tests, backend contracts and mobile tests pass.
A plain-text section title or body within its length limit is accepted as the requested locale; empty, too long or non-string values are still rejected.
untouchedSurfaces: Acceptance rules for Tarot output, prompts and data are unchanged.
Deploying ai-tarot-reading waits for Owner approval.
